name: tail
purpose: Display the last lines (default 10) of a file or follow live log updates.
explanation: Prints the end of a file—especially useful for viewing the most recent entries in server logs.

parameters.description: Follow — continuously stream new lines appended to the file.

explanationOfOutput: Displays the most recent 20 lines at the bottom of `server.log`.
whenToUse: To inspect recent log entries or monitor live logs.
commonErrors: tail: server.log: No such file or directory
